name: logistics
description: Logistics fulfillment analysis: VTR, OTR, matching, anomaly detection

tools.name: logistics_match
tools.description: Match orders with tracking data by order_id and tracking_no. Returns match rate and confidence.

mapping.description: Field mapping (optional, uses AI auto-mapping if not provided)

tools.name: logistics_kpi
tools.description: Calculate VTR, OTR, avg delivery times, by carrier/size/prime segments.

tools.name: logistics_anomaly
tools.description: Detect anomalies: missing scans, time inversions, past-promise, stale shipments.

tools.name: logistics_report
tools.description: Generate complete XLSX report with KPI, carrier comparison, and anomalies.
